test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some toffies are candies.

Some candies are chocolates.

All chocolates are lollipops.

**Conclusions:**

I. No lollipop is toffy.

II. Some lollipops are candies.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follow.

solution:
Statements:

Some toffies are candies.

Some candies are chocolates.

All chocolates are lollipops.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3407a4fa7bce73aee2f2d4ddca137f7485f6b14043d04c3af7d3929b7d95d1e0.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No lollipop is toffy. - **False **(Because, there is no relation given between lollipop and toffy, so it can be possible but not definite)

II. Some lollipops are candies. - **True **(Because, Some candies are chocolates and All chocolates are lollipops, so, Some lollipops are also candies)

So, Only conclusion II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Only conclusion II follow.".**
